title: Show Hidden (ArrangeAndOrganize)

scenarios.title: Show Hidden applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Show Hidden (BtnShowHidden) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: BtnShowHidden documented selection scope

requirements.text: Show Hidden is enabled at its documented selection scope (hidden shapes on the slide) and refused otherwise; the deterministic host-free scenario pins that scope contract.

scenarios.expected: Show Hidden is enabled at its documented selection scope (hidden shapes on the slide) and refused otherwise; the deterministic host-free scenario pins that scope contract.

done.statement: The deterministic host-free scenario passes; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews (office-only gate) remains until the office leg has real-host evidence and review.

scenarios.title: BtnShowHidden deterministic Office leg

requirements.text: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Show Hidden restores the shapes hidden through Hide Selected (feature-tagged) on the slide, reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Show Hidden restores the shapes hidden through Hide Selected (feature-tagged) on the slide, reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.
